subject: Request: additional eval credits and extended window for RFP comparison
messages:
From: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@helixhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Eval credits for vendor comparison (GaleAI RFP)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and latency profiles looked great. We have an internal bake-off running this month against GaleAI and one other vendor. Procurement asked us to be conservative with seats/time, so we're constrained on usage.

Can Redwood consider: (a) an uplifted eval credit package (we're asking for ~150k tokens or equivalent compute credits) and (b) a 45-day window instead of the standard 30 days? That extra time would let our ML team run longer prompt/edge-case sweeps.

We may need a short engineering sync to validate KV caching behavior for multi-turn clinical transcripts. Procurement is on copy for terms.

Appreciate any flexibility — this is an active RFP, decision in early September.

Best,
Sarah Klein
Director, Applied ML
Helix Health

--
Attachment: bakeoff-specs.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@helixhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Eval credits for vendor comparison (GaleAI RFP)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and for running Redwood in the comparison.

Short answer: we can be flexible. Proposed counter: 100k tokens + 2 engineering hours in the next 2 weeks, 45-day window. If you can share a quick prioritized checklist of the tests you plan to run (latency P95 targets, longest context lengths, KV reuse scenarios), we can scope the engineering time appropriately.

Aditya (cc) — can you confirm if we can approve 100k from playbook, and what authority we need for a stretch to 150k? Also tagging procurement on the timeline.

I attached our standard eval terms for an expedited signoff if that helps.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Redwood_Eval_Terms_v1.pdf (terms stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Eval credits for vendor comparison (GaleAI RFP)

Soojin — quick internal note on approvals.

- Playbook authorizes AE-level approvals up to 100k tokens for competitive evals when customer is genuine and there's an active RFP.
- Anything >100k requires manager approval (Marcus) and be tied to a clear success metric (e.g., feature parity test list + decision date).
- If Helix wants 150k, suggest we offer 125k as a compromise plus the 45-day window and 3 engineering hours (one deep sync + a follow-up). That keeps discount exposure limited and shows commitment.

I've sketched a short plan in the attached eval-credit-plan.xlsx — includes proposed milestones and an ask to Procurement to sign our expedited terms (Redwood_Eval_Terms_v2).

Aditya
Senior Sales Ops

--
Attachment: eval-credit-plan.xlsx (planning worksheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Eval credits for vendor comparison (GaleAI RFP)

Thanks Aditya — I can approve up to 125k tokens + 45 days and the 3 engineering hours, provided we capture a short mutual action plan and the customer agrees to a brief post-eval review (15–30 mins) to capture win/loss learnings.

Soojin — please present that offer to Sarah as the final counter. If they push for 150k, we'll consider a 150k offer but with a tighter SLA on usage reporting and a commitment to purchase by end of next quarter if metrics are met.

Marcus
Sales Manager

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Sarah Klein <sarah.klein@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 08:33:00 -0400
Subject: Final: Eval credit offer and next steps

Hi Sarah — appreciate the patience while we reviewed internally.

Final offer from Redwood: 125k tokens (or equivalent compute credit), 45-day evaluation window, and three engineering hours (one kickoff + two follow-ups) to help validate KV caching and multi-turn clinical transcript handling.

Conditions:
- Sign our expedited eval terms (attached Redwood_Eval_Terms_v2.pdf).
- Agree to a 20–30 minute post-eval review meeting to share results and next steps.
- If you require 150k, we can consider it only with a memorandum of intent to move forward with a paid pilot by end of Q4 and additional usage reporting during the trial.

If that works, I'll have legal/procurement send over the short signature packet and schedule the engineering kickoff — suggested slots: Aug 19 or 20.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to iron details.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

--
Attachment: Redwood_Eval_Terms_v2.pdf (updated expedited terms)
